# Michal Sambora

Also known as SAMBO (styled sambø) and SAMBOREK. These names refer to the same designer, Michal Sambora, whose official portfolio is msambora.com. His Dribbble and Behance profiles use the handle samborek.

> Senior product designer and startup design partner based in Krakow, Poland. Portfolio of UI/UX, design systems, prototyping, and visual design work.

This is a reading guide to the public portfolio. Project pages are the source for project scope and credits; the offer page describes services and collaboration models.

## Portfolio and services

- [Portfolio](https://msambora.com/): Selected work, professional background, clients, and contact details.
- [Product design offer](https://msambora.com/work/cooperation.html): Product UI/UX, visual design, prototyping, design systems, implementation support, and collaboration options.

## Selected projects

- [Hydration](https://msambora.com/work/hydration.html): DeFi interface redesign, design tokens, mobile experience, and QA. [Product](https://app.hydration.net/).
- [HydraDX](https://msambora.com/work/hydradx.html): Product UI and design system work.
- [Basilisk](https://msambora.com/work/basilisk.html): Trading, wallet, and farming interface design.
- [Plaant](https://msambora.com/work/plaant.html): Brand and app design for home hydroponics.
